long_biography.plain_text:
Şahenk returned to Turkey after studying marketing and human resources at Boston College, beginning in investment banking and founding Garanti Securities. He later led Doğuş Automotive before succeeding his father, founder Ayhan Şahenk, as head of the family group in 2001. Garanti Bank remained the cornerstone of the inherited fortune during his early tenure.

Selling the family's final Garanti stake marked a strategic turn toward consumer and retail services. Şahenk assembled a portfolio spanning automotive distribution, luxury hotels and restaurants, property, construction, media, energy and technology, while building international partnerships with Volkswagen, Hyatt and Peninsula Hotels. He remains Doğuş Group's chairman and chief executive, directing the diversified group through its next phase.
